parent_objective: synthesize the paper-route finite-window vs GRU evidence branch before continuing
blocked_by: workflow synthesis cadence fired after M1204
supersedes: creating another narrow corrected pilot design without branch synthesis
invalidates: continuing the profile-comparison branch without summarizing M1195-M1204 evidence and risks

public_gates: M1205 may synthesize existing evidence only
M1205 must not run candidate replay
M1205 must not use private holdout
M1205 must not claim profile superiority or self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_branch_synthesis: M1195-M1204 finite-window vs GRU evidence state
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: summarizes the profile-mask training path, smoke pilots, M1199 public trend, M1201 separability audit, and M1203-M1204 control repair before next branch action
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: synthesis only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if evidence is insufficient to continue corrected pilot route
stop if metric artifacts still block corrected comparison
stop if current-tiled controls are not ready
stop if next branch would need private holdout
fallback_plan: continue to corrected pilot design if controls and evidence are ready
pivot to task/history-necessity design if profile controls remain confounded
stop the branch if evidence quality is too weak
route to implementation repair if corrected-control smoke is insufficient
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1195-M1204 completed 10 non-synthesis milestones after the previous synthesis

admission_evidence: M1195 integrates profile masks into train/eval vector paths
M1199 produces a public pilot trend
M1201 identifies current-frame substitution and reset metric artifact
M1203/M1204 implement and smoke corrected controls
blocked_shortcuts: do not train controllers in M1205
do not make performance or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review
next_stage_criteria: supported and falsified claims are separated

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1205 must summarize M1201's high current-frame substitution risk and keep self-ID claims blocked.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Synthesis only; no new temporal evidence is produced.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record metric artifacts and current-frame substitution as blockers for strong history claims, not as reasons to weaken claim standards.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The M1195-M1204 finite-window vs GRU evidence branch can be synthesized into a safe next-route decision.
success_criteria: no training, PPO, candidate replay, promotion, private holdout, per-profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
failure_criteria: synthesis skips metric artifact or current-frame substitution risks
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
synthesis makes paper-level or self-ID claims

decision_rule: M1205 passes if it answers the required synthesis questions and selects the next branch route without training, tuning, promotion, private holdout, or claim expansion.
